Description:
I-Syden yindawo yokuxoxa nabangane bakho ngezwi, ngevidiyo nangombhalo. Amagumbi ezwi ahlala evulekile, ukusakaza isikrini kanye nomsindo, ingxoxo enama-emoji nemisindo — konke iqembu elikudingayo ukuze lidlale ndawonye, libuke ndawonye noma lixoxe nje.

Mahhala ngempela
Akukho uhlelo olukhokhelwayo, akukho ukubhalisela okukhokhelwayo futhi akukho lutho oluvaliwe olulinde inkokhelo. Yonke imihlobiso yephrofayela imahhala. Ofuna ukunikela unikela ngoba ethanda — futhi wayesevele ekwazi ukufinyelela kukho konke ngaphambi kwalokho.

Ayikho imikhangiso, akudayiswa idatha
I-Syden ayinayo imikhangiso, ayidayisi idatha yakho futhi ayisebenzisi izingxoxo zakho nganoma yini ngaphandle kokuzidlulisela kulowo okhuluma naye. Izwi, ividiyo nezikrini ezabiwe akuqoshwa.

Kwenzelwe amaqembu, hhayi izixuku
Ungena emiphakathini ngesimemo. Nguwe okhetha ukuthi ngubani ongaphakathi, futhi umphakathi ngamunye uneziteshi zawo, ama-emoji nemisindo yawo. Ungavimba noma ubani okuhluphayo, ubike okungalungile futhi uphume noma nini lapho uthanda, uthathe idatha yakho.

Okungaphakathi
• Amagumbi ezwi anevidiyo nokusakaza isikrini kanye nomsindo
• Ukucindezela umsindo okuthulisa ifeni nomsindo wangemuva
• Ingxoxo enokunamathiselwe, izimpendulo, izinchungechunge nezinhlolovo
• Ama-emoji nemisindo okwakhiwa umphakathi ngokwawo
• I-Karaoke, ibhodi lemisindo nemiphumela yezwi
• Izingxoxo eziyimfihlo kanye nohlu lwabangane
• Imodi yeseshini, ukuze nibuke ndawonye nengxoxo eceleni
• Ikhaya le-pixel art: igumbi likanogwaja, emini nasebusuku
• Itimu ekhanyayo nemnyama, ngezilimi ezingaphezu kwama-70

I-Syden isebenza kusiphequluli nakulolu hlelo lokusebenza, nge-akhawunti efanayo.
